Header: Chilo partellus , Sesamia spp. In Sinhala: Puruk Panuva, In Tamil: Solam thandu thulaippan

Prevention: For the maha season crop, initiate planting during the first week of
October to avoid the peak population which occurs in
Apply nitrogen fertilizer at recommended rate at basal dressing and 3 to 4 weeks after sowing.
Monitoring: Holes on the stems and leaves and also for excreta of the pest
Direct Control (Non-chemical): Remove and destroy the plants with infested stems to prevent its spread and secondary infections
Direct Control (Chemical): Use protective clothing when applying pesticides
Don’t eat or drink while using pesticides and take suitable precautions when disposing of materials
Restrictions: Repeated application may lead to resistance buildup.
Place granules (one of the following two) in the central whorl at 3rd and 5th weeks after planting.
Directly spray one of the following insecticide to the central whorl at 25-35 days and at 45-55 days after planting.
